test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

R _ _ RT _ R _ R _ TR
solution:
Given : R _ _ RT _ R _ R _ TR

By checking options :

 
• RTRRT → R __**R**__ __**T**__ RT __**R**__ R __**R**__ R __**T**__ TR → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• TTTRR → R __T__ __T__ RT __T__ R __R__ R __R__ TR → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• TRRTR → R __T__ __R__ RT __R__ R __T__ R __R__ TR → (It follows the pattern of : RTR - RTR - RTR - RTR)
 
• RTTTR → R __R__ __T__ RT __T__ R __T__ R __R__ TR → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (3) gives the pattern of " R __T__ __R__ - RT __R__ - R __T__ R - __R__ TR "

Hence, "**TRRTR**" is the correct answer.
